skill_name: Please describe the current government of India
workflow: India is a federal parliamentary republic governed under the Constitution of India. The government is composed of three branches - executive, legislative, and judicial - and is headed by the President, who is the head of state and commander-in-chief of the Indian Armed Forces. The Government is divided into 28 states and 8 union territories, with the Prime Minister as the head of the Government. The Prime Minister also serves as the head of the Council of Ministers and leads the executive branch
